name: Gibo Kyoushi
source:
Izumi Sayuki...she's my teacher, my stepmother, and what she becomes next is up to you and the choices you make...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042956.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
泉纱雪……她是我的老师，我的继母，她接下来会变成什么样子取决于你和你的选择……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ042956.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
